name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather for a city.

unit.description: Temperature unit; include only when the user names one.

name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer. Hours are converted to minutes.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm clock for a time of day.

name: send_message
description: Send a text message to a contact.

name: call_contact
description: Place a phone call to a contact.

name: play_music
description: Play music by song, artist, album, or genre.

name: navigate_to
description: Start turn-by-turn navigation to a destination.

mode.description: Travel mode; include only when stated.

name: create_event
description: Add an event to the calendar.

time.description: Start time in 24-hour HH:MM; include only when stated.

name: control_lights
description: Turn lights on or off in a room, or dim them to a brightness percentage. Never use this for any other device.

brightness_percent.description: Brightness from 0 to 100, only with a dim request that names a number.

name: set_thermostat
description: Set the home thermostat target temperature in degrees Celsius.
